integrity: The proof is exact and reduces the unit-sphere optimization to four relative-permutation cases. A standalone exact checker verifies the symmetry bookkeeping, polynomial maximum certificate, and equality configuration. Independent audit has not been performed.
scientific_limitations: The theorem is only for the stated real two-dimensional affine-regular hexagonal norm. It does not classify all maximizers or assert a formula for arbitrary polygonal spaces. Bibliographic searches cannot prove universal absence of an equivalent result under different terminology.
title: Exact Dehghan–Rooin constant of the affine-regular hexagonal plane
